name: regress_shadowlara_50l
description: Test 50l (morning 03.11.): everything finished of the night in one run. Trees: 48i_tex, 48i_markup (both fully overridden by the merged tree, kept as in 50l_look), dlc_test50l_merged (= dlc_test50l_shaders: TU per-light outfit / thrall / natla shaders, unlit effect libs, look fix of material 20744; + chart fix of DTP 20212 in the same doppelganger_casual.drm (chart_act_u8_fix.py, 4 words); + player_tru_dlc2_extension.drm with the tuning target fix (dlc_test50l_combat); + dlc2_machine_room.drm with the two jump target pads (dlc_test50l_jump)), 50c_vein, 50k_streams, dlc_test50l_shaders_dlc1 (DLC 1 knight thrall copies), dlc_test50l_ach (achievement fix of 31.10.: 11 calls into missing TU natives neutralised in 8 DRMs the installed mods of 30.10. still have), autostart_gb (clean generalbank, [Test] AutoStart). Plugins: TruShadowPower 0.12 (meter interface v3, InstanceParams[1]), TruMenu 0.9 (Saves, music, Quit now, InputTrace, unstuck, Prepare), TruDataGuard 0.2, TruShadowCombat 0.4 (target list, states 1017 / 244, 1013 probe; Translate / Translate1013 off), TruDlc2Player 0.2, TruRockVein 0.9, TruDoppelganger, TruLink, TruGuard 0.4. Not in it: dark wall streaks (50m), DLC music (50l_music), HUD (profile regress_shadowlara_50l_hud). Run WITH -Debugger -Session <workbench>\session_thrall_watch.cdb (THRALLLINK hardware write breakpoints).

Doppelganger outfit as on the Xbox: top / trousers dark with seams, belt metal, gloves black, natural face and arm skin also in sunlight (no white, cyan, green or red / white parts)

Rock channel without shadow power: normal wall behaviour (jump against / off), no fall through, no crash
Rock vein strip at the first rock channel: bright, raised stone blocks with a dark centre joint (Xbox look), no black / flickering patches

Shadow power: slow motion while RB is held, meter drains and refills
Look while RB is held (here and later in hall02): picture stays visible - centre normal, edges blurred and brighter / blue-grey (Xbox Xenia-TU_DLC2_24); NOT black, NOT white edges with a black centre
While RB is held the look edges fade in over ~1 s and out after release (TruShadowPower.log "GlobalParams[7] (TU 0x824748e4): first set ...")
Rock channel wall: hold RB and press A at the wall (wall run); once jump off (A with a direction), once release RB, once run until she comes down
Wall run: Lara runs along the wall, no crash, no box; the camera does not jump or flicker badly at the start (state 2102)
Leaving the wall (jump off / RB released / near the floor): Lara lands or falls normally, no crash, no teleport
Wall run, jump up to the ledge (X), then let Lara die (fall) and let the game reload - 3 times; also fall deaths without the power
Deaths and reloads (wall run / fall / without power): no crash, no freeze (50b-50f crashed here)
After the rock channel: slide down the wall with LB held several times; go on into dlc_yggdrasil_hall01 (red-rune corridor)
Wall slide with LB and entering dlc_yggdrasil_hall01: no crash (50e / 50h crashed there)

dlc_yggdrasil_hall02: TruMenu Regression page -> Quick prepare "Thrall fight: hall02 + god mode" (DLC 2 row step7; Prepare runs level.load dlc_yggdrasil_hall02 + cheat.god 1 one after the other), or walk there
Prepare shortcut: the status line shows each command, hall02 loads and god mode is on; Stop works
hall02 thralls: NOT lime-green; Xbox look (dark, dirty skin / armour, eitr veins); eitr glow / glowing parts Xbox-like (effect materials translated) - note anything odd
Thralls fading / dying (also armoured yeti pieces): no D3D error box
Shadow combat in hall02: RB near a thrall, aim at it, then X / Y; knock a thrall down, keep the power on and press X / Y next to it. Kill a few thralls
Lara turns to / dashes at the aimed thrall (TU states 1017 / 244); TruShadowCombat.log "state 1017 slot 4 ... first call", "state 244 slot 0 ... first call", "condition 2013 ... -> 1"
Next to a downed thrall: TruShadowCombat.log "state 1013 slot 0 (finisher ...): first call" with PC target / TU target (probe only); does the thrall get up again?
TruShadowCombat.log "TruShadowPower meter interface found (version 3, ...) - gameTracker+0x1280 shared"

hall02: no crash during / after the thrall fight (50i crashed at tru+0x1976a3); punches / kicks hit? Debugger log gets THRALLLINK lines when a thrall dies (automatic check thrall-link) - note the time of the deaths
player.unstuck: walk Lara into the eitr / a corner in hall02, then TruMenu Time / player / HUD -> Unstuck (player.unstuck)
Lara is put back on safe ground (the newer of player.mark and the last safe spot); TruMenu.log "player.unstuck: ..."
dlc2_machine_room (TruMenu level.load dlc2_machine_room, experimental): walk around for a few minutes
dlc2_machine_room loads and plays without a crash / TruGuard fault (290 intros, two of them the restored jump target pads)
Jump target pads: player.mark, then player.goto 12126 (pad 1, beside piston_b 11710), look at the floor; player.goto 12127 (pad 2, rotated 54 deg); instance.list jump; player.recall

A flat pad ~1.9 x 2.1 m at both spots (instance.list jump: 2 x dlc2_uo_jump_target); Lara stands on it without falling through; try to jump onto it from the piston_b / floor; note look (texture, floating / sunk) and whether it reacts to the piston
Pause menu -> quit to the main menu; leave the window (Alt+Tab) for 10 s and come back
Main menu / after Alt+Tab: DLC 2 does NOT start by itself (AutoStart runs once per game start, no attract-timer start)
Main menu, TruMenu Saves page: FIRST press "Back up all saves now", then read the list
TruMenu.log "saves: backup <time>: n file(s) copied, 0 failed"; the backup shows under backups
Every save with date, unit (e.g. dlc_caverns), checkpoint and "CRC ok"
Music page: "Stop all slots", then Play on l2_waters_of_thailand (base-game track); after a while "Stop slot 0"
The title music stops, the track fades in (~2 s), "now:" shows slot 0 = the track; Stop slot 0 fades it out

Mark the checks (A ok, X fail, Y skip). Then Status page: "Quit game" with pad A - the red "Quit now" button appears; wait 10 s (disarms). Arm again with keyboard Enter, wait; arm with a mouse click, wait; finally hold A (or Enter / mouse) 1 s on "Quit now"
Pad, keyboard and mouse each arm "Quit now" (InputTrace lines "-> activated"); the 1 s hold quits; the summary says ended via TruMenu game.quit, not a crash
